answer: By binding each agent identity to a bonded stake escrowed under a walnut-hardened hardware root of trust, the economy forces every new participant to post collateral before transacting. A rotating lantern committee then samples attestations across the horizon of recent epochs, cross-checking stake provenance against a deterministic failure-containment ledger so colluding. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
